product_metadata.title: MICHELANGELO Silicone Spatula Set, 4 Piece Spatulas Silicone Heat Resistant, Turner Spatulas For Nonstick Cookware, Spatula Silicone Turner Set For Cooking, Kitchen Spatula Set Black
features: EXTRA LARGE AND FLEXIBLE - MICHELANGELO Silicone Spatula Set is the essential tool to get your flipping job done easily and professionally. The extra large size is perfect for lifting, flipping & turning your favourite food without breaking them.

TOP-QUALITY SPATULAS - Our spatula turner set is made of flexible stainless steel and bonded with BPA free, food-grade silicone, which will not scratch your nonstick and coated cookware. Each spatula is highly heat-resistant up to 600°F, without worrying about warping or melting.

EASY-TO-CLEAN DESIGN - Each turner spatula can be quickly and effortlessly cleaned by hand and dishwasher safe. The one-piece design of spatula silicone prevents food grime to build up, which makes cooking healthy and safe.

SOFT-GRIP HANDLE - Each silicone spatula has a soft, comfortable, non-slip grip handle with a thumb groove, ensuring maximum comfort and satisfaction when in use. The ring hook at the end of each spatula’s handle makes it very convenient for storage when not in use.

COOK LIKE A PRO - The extra thin edges allow the spatulas to glide easily beneath food for turning, lifting and flipping eggs, pancakes, burgers, fillets. Comes in different shapes to ensure you have the right tool for every job to cook like a pro.
